column2: Periodically takes magical damage. Damage is based on the applier's total attributes, and all stacks contribute to total poison damage.
column3: 周期性受到魔法伤害。伤害基于施加者全属性，所有层数共同参与总毒伤害计算。

column2: Cannot critically strike. Affected by damage over time bonuses.
column3: 无法触发暴击，受到持续伤害加成影响，默认伤害间隔为0.5秒。

column2: Let storm energy flood your body, briefly entering Thunderized state. Some monster skills are deflected by this charge, and Lightning Walls yield a path for you; the power fades after your next main attack.
column3: 让风暴能量灌注身体，短暂进入雷化状态。部分怪物技能会被这层电荷偏转，雷墙也会对你让出通路；这份力量会在下一次主攻击后消散。

column2: While Thunderized, your main attack can tear into the magical structure of a monster's cast. If it hits a suitable target, the skill is interrupted and the monster briefly falters.
column3: 在雷化状态下发动主攻击，可撕开怪物施法时形成的魔力结构。若命中合适的目标，其技能会被中断，并陷入短暂失衡。

column2: Enter Thunderized state at the critical instant before a monster skill finishes charging. If the timing is precise, the storm briefly answers, making your movement and next attack more lethal.
column3: 在怪物技能即将完成蓄力的临界瞬间进入雷化。若时机足够精确，风暴会短暂回应，使你的移动与下一次攻击更加致命。

column2: Periodically takes pure damage. Normal targets take 15% of current health per second, elites take 7.5%, and bosses/chieftains take 1.5%; healing and regeneration received are reduced by 25%.
column3: 周期性受到纯粹伤害。普通目标每秒受到当前生命值 15%，精英 7.5%，头目和首领 1.5%；治疗与恢复效果降低 25%。

column2: Deals pure damage to enemies every second based on Intelligence and Strength, and reduces their armor and magic resistance.
column3: 每秒使敌人受到基于智力和力量的纯粹伤害，并降低其护甲和魔法抗性。

column2: Blocks non-pure damage. It will not recover for 3 seconds after taking damage; once recovery starts, it restores 25% per second.
column3: 抵挡非纯粹伤害。受到伤害后 3 秒内不会恢复；开始恢复后每秒恢复 25%。

column2: Periodically takes physical damage. Damage is based on the final damage that triggered Bleed; repeated applications merge remaining damage and refresh the duration.
column3: 流血仅可能被物理伤害触发,周期受到纯粹伤害,伤害基于触发流血一击的最终伤害的70%,同时仅受到流血伤害和持续伤害加成。

column2: Movement speed and attack speed are reduced. Each stack reduces them by 3%, up to 10 stacks.
column3: 移动速度和攻击速度降低。每层降低 3%，最高叠加 10 层。

column2: Reduces monster attack speed and movement speed.
column3: 怪物的攻击速度和移动速度降低。

column2: Unable to move attack or cast. Duration is affected by stun resistance.
column3: 无法移动、攻击或施法。持续时间会受到眩晕抗性影响。

column2: Increases all damage taken. Starts at 15%, with +2% per extra stack, up to 25%.
column3: 承受的所有伤害提高。初始提高 15%，每层额外提高 2%，最高 25%。

column2: Normal attacks have a chance to deal higher damage. Initial attack crit chance is 5%, and crit damage is 180%.
column3: 普通攻击有概率造成更高伤害。初始暴击为 5%，暴击伤害为 180%。

column2: Ability damage has a chance to deal higher damage. Initial crit damage is 180%; when triggered, it uses the current crit damage multiplier.
column3: 技能伤害有概率造成更高伤害。初始暴击伤害为 180%。触发后使用当前暴击伤害倍率。

column2: Has a chance to dodge attacks. Multiple evasion sources are calculated separately.
column3: 有概率躲避攻击。多个闪避来源会分别计算。

column2: A light emitted by the unit that can dispel darkness.
column3: 自身发出光亮，可以驱散黑暗。
受到的治疗和吸血效果降低。
会触发所有攻击触发效果。

column2: Consumed according to charge count and unaffected by cooldown reduction.
column3: 按照充能次数消耗，不受冷却缩减影响。

column2: Stored gold will not drop on death and does not take backpack space.
column3: 储存的金币不会因为死亡掉落，也不会占用背包空间。

column2: Pure damage ignores armor and magic resistance, but cannot crit.
column3: 纯粹伤害无视护甲和魔法抗性，但是无法暴击。
提高造成的魔法类型伤害。

column2: The health actually lost after damage bonuses, critical strikes, defenses, damage taken modifiers, blocks, shields, and other effects are resolved.
column3: 对伤害最终结算进行单独乘算加成。

column2: Hold Alt to view term details
column3: 按住 Alt 查看词条说明

column2: Final damage taken = damage / (1 + Damage Resistance). In this calculation, 100% Damage Resistance equals 1.
column3: 最终受到伤害 = 伤害 ÷（1 + 伤害抵抗）。计算时，100%伤害抵抗按1计。

column2: Hold the configured hotkey to keep moving your hero toward the cursor. You can untick it at any time to pause this behavior.
column3: 按住已设置的快捷键时，英雄会持续向鼠标指向位置移动。可随时取消勾选来暂停使用。

column2: After clearing it you need to set a hotkey again before it can be enabled.
column3: 清除后需要重新设置快捷键才能启用。

column2: When enabled you will see item pickup notices from other players. Your own pickup notices are always shown.
column3: 开启后会显示其他玩家拾取物品的通知。关闭后仍会显示你自己的拾取信息。

column2: When enabled the camera follows your hero. When disabled it returns to normal camera control.
column3: 开启后镜头会跟随你的英雄。关闭后恢复为普通镜头控制。

column2: When enabled term details in ability and item descriptions are collapsed by default and expand while holding Alt.
column3: 开启后，技能和物品说明中的词条说明默认收起，仅在按住 Alt 时展开。

column2: When enabled the map plays Axe King BGM. When disabled a silent music loop is played to suppress both native and custom BGM.
column3: 开启后播放本地图 BGM。关闭后会播放静音音乐循环，用于压住原生和自定义 BGM。

column2: When enabled, combined normal damage numbers are displayed. Critical-hit numbers and hit effects are always shown.
column3: 开启后会显示合并后的普通伤害数字。暴击数字和受击特效始终显示。

column2: When enabled, newly created skill and equipment effects from your own hero are hidden. Other players, monsters, and system effects are unaffected.
column3: 开启后不再显示自己英雄的新建技能和装备特效，其他玩家、怪物和系统特效不受影响。

column2: When enabled, newly created skill and equipment effects from other heroes are hidden. Monster and system effects are unaffected.
column3: 开启后不再显示其他英雄的新建技能和装备特效，怪物和系统特效不受影响。

column2: Use this only when your hero is stuck. You will die voluntarily, take normal death penalties, and will not trigger revive, death prevention, or save effects.
column3: 仅在英雄卡住时使用。使用后会主动阵亡并承受正常死亡惩罚，不会触发复活、免死或防死效果。

column2: You are currently at the base. Click to move your hero precisely to the base transfer point without triggering death, cooldown, or settlement.
